name: improve_bench_ideas_vectors
description: A collection of precomputed vector embeddings aligned with benchmark 'ideas' intended to support retrieval-augmented experiments for mathematical problem solving and benchmark-improvement research. The dataset provides embeddings to enable fast retrieval, reranking, and similarity experiments without re-encoding source texts. It is mainly useful for RAG-style pipelines and retrieval-quality studies in the math domain.
reputation: Niche dataset primarily used within RAG/math retrieval research; limited broader adoption.
